title: Shared Company Cloud and Creator Ownership
notes: Adds a Trinity-wide operational cloud for shared Drill Logs and Shot Diagrams.
Administrators and Blasters can view and edit all shared operational records.
Drillers can view shared Drill Logs but can upload changes only to Drill Logs they created.
Drivers can view shared Shot Diagrams but can upload changes only to Shot Diagrams they created.
Creator identity is immutable after a shared record is created, preventing field users from taking ownership of another user's file.
Only Administrators can permanently delete shared records, manage users, or migrate private cloud records.
Pending Member accounts have no field-template or cloud permissions until an Administrator assigns a role.
Preserves the m40.9.6.8 document engine, keypad fixes, exports, calculations, backgrounds, and local device data.
